26.001.name: SceneInfo
26.001.note: Bit 6 is 0 for scene active and 1 for scene inactive; it is not a learn/store flag.

206.100.name: HVACModeNext
206.100.note: LTE compound structure: delay in minutes followed by mode. Zero delay means undefined; zero mode means undefined. Allowed combinations depend on the datapoint specification. Not available in Standard Mode.

206.102.name: DHWModeNext
206.102.note: LTE compound structure: delay in minutes followed by mode. Zero delay means undefined; zero mode means undefined. Allowed combinations depend on the datapoint specification. Not available in Standard Mode.

206.104.name: OccModeNext
206.104.note: LTE compound structure: delay in minutes followed by mode. Zero delay means next mode not available. Not available in Standard Mode.

206.105.name: BuildingModeNext
206.105.note: LTE compound structure: delay in minutes followed by mode. Zero delay means next mode not available. Not available in Standard Mode.

238.600.name: DALI_Diagnostics
238.600.note: Diagnostic status: two failure flags followed by a six-bit DALI device address.

242.600.name: Colour_xyY
242.600.note: x and y are rounded onto 0–65535; brightness uses DPT 5.001 scaling. Independent validity flags; reserved bits zero. Encoding does not establish that a colour is physically achievable.

244.600.name: Converter_Status
244.600.note: Converter mode and hardware status followed by four two-bit status enums. Unlisted enum codes are reserved; hardware bits 2 and 3 must be zero.
